name: org.machanism.machai:genai-client
description: GenAI Client is a Java 8 library for integrating Machai applications with generative AI providers through a common provider abstraction. It supplies the org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai conversation lifecycle for initialization, system instructions, prompts, local function tools, reusable prompts, resources, project-directory context, configurable tool-error handling, and response execution. The library includes OpenAI Responses API and embedding support, Anthropic Claude Messages API support, EPAM CodeMie OAuth 2.0 delegation to OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic backends, deterministic YAML-driven local tool execution, and a no-op provider for safe disabled or test configurations. org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.GenaiProviderManager resolves provider:model identifiers, while Usage and UsageStatistics capture and aggregate per-model token metrics. The org.machanism.machai.ai.tools SPI enables ServiceLoader-discovered Java tool bundles using runtime annotations for callable tools, prompt definitions, resources, parameter metadata, and application compatibility. It supports AI application development, prompt orchestration, agent tool calling, semantic embeddings, semantic search, Model Context Protocol server registration, and optional web search.

constructors.description: Creates an OpenAI-backed Genai provider. Initialize it with a model and Configurator before submitting prompts. Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and optionally OPENAI_BASE_URL, GENAI_TIMEOUT, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, web search, or MCP servers.

examples.description: Create, initialize, invoke, and reset an OpenAI provider. The configurator must supply the OpenAI credentials before perform is called.

constructors.description: Creates a ServiceLoader-based loader that discovers FunctionTools implementations on the classpath and registers compatible annotated tools and prompts with a Genai provider.

examples.description: Use after provider initialization to load compatible local tool bundles declared in META-INF/services.

features.name: getProvider
features.description: Resolves, instantiates, and initializes a Genai provider from Provider:Model notation or a fully qualified provider class. Conventional provider classes are resolved from org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.impl.

examples.description: Resolve an OpenAI provider from configuration and run a practical text-generation request.

features.name: embedding
features.description: Generates a provider-specific embedding vector for text, supporting semantic search, similarity comparison, and retrieval workflows. OpenAIProvider and CodeMieProvider implement this capability.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.EmbeddingProvider embedder = org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.GenaiProviderManager.getEmbeddingProvider("OpenAI:text-embedding-3-small", configurator);
java.util.List<java.lang.Double> vector = embedder.embedding("Java AI provider integration", 384L);
examples.description: Resolve an embedding provider and create a vector suitable for storing in a semantic-search index.

features.name: addTools
features.description: Registers public methods annotated with Tool from a FunctionTools bundle as model-callable local functions. The shared provider implementation derives parameter schemas from Param metadata and supplies configured project and configuration context during invocation.

examples.description: Register host-side Java capabilities before a provider request so the model can call an approved application tool.

features.name: applyTools
features.description: Applies ServiceLoader-discovered FunctionTools implementations compatible with the supplied application class. Compatible bundles register both callable tools and reusable prompts.

examples.description: Automatically install all compatible tool bundles rather than registering each bundle manually.

features.name: getUsageForModel
features.description: Returns a defensive copy of token usage entries recorded for a model identifier, enabling application-level monitoring and cost reporting.

examples.description: Retrieve token-usage records after provider calls for operational reporting.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai
studs.description: Primary provider contract for initializing an AI backend, accumulating prompts and instructions, registering tools and resources, configuring tool execution, and producing a response.

examples.description: Program against the common Genai interface so provider implementation can be selected from configuration.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.EmbeddingProvider
studs.description: Contract for initialized AI providers that produce numeric vectors from input text.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.EmbeddingProvider embedder = org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.GenaiProviderManager.getEmbeddingProvider("OpenAI:text-embedding-3-small", configurator);
java.util.List<java.lang.Double> vector = embedder.embedding("Searchable documentation", 384L);
examples.description: Use the abstraction to generate a vector for a semantic retrieval pipeline.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools
studs.description: Marker SPI for Java classes that provide annotated local AI tools, prompts, or resources and may be discovered through ServiceLoader.

examples.description: Implement the SPI and annotate public methods to expose a controlled host capability. Add the fully qualified class name to META-INF/services/org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools for automatic discovery.

examples.title: Install and invoke the OpenAI provider
steps: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY in the Configurator source used by the application; optionally configure OPENAI_BASE_URL and GENAI_TIMEOUT.
Resolve OpenAI:gpt-4o-mini through GenaiProviderManager, add a prompt, invoke perform, then call clear before reusing the provider.

examples.title: Install a custom ServiceLoader tool bundle
steps: Install genai-client with the Maven dependency shown in the previous example.
Create a public class implementing org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools and annotate public methods with Tool and Param.
Create src/main/resources/META-INF/services/org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools containing the tool class fully qualified name.
Construct FunctionToolsLoader and call applyTools after the Genai provider is initialized.
